newsitem.title: USA: Chile buys Forcados, Oriente crudes for late-May.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys Forcados, Oriente crudes for late-May.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought 900,000 barrels of Nigerian Forcados and 380,000 barrels of Ecuadoran Oriente in its latest crude oil purchase tender, trade sources said on Friday.
A variable of plus or minus 10 percent was agreed on the Oriente volume, the sources said.
The cargoes will be delivered between the end of May and early June.

The prices for the transactions were not disclosed. Traders said the Forcados was pegged to either benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing or dated Brent, while Oriente was sold at a discount to WTI.
Elewhere in the region, an Argentine company is offering 380,000 barrels of Canadon Seco crude for loading May 10-11, trade sources said.
